# `state/consistency/Reservation.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/consistency/Reservation.js`

state/consistency/Reservation.js — reservations + bounded-counter escrow (spec §5 fragmentation fix, §10, rule 16).  Two coordination-avoidance tools that sit in front of the commit path:  • ReservationManager — a reservation is itself a USO (single-use, exclusive). Reserving a scarce resource creates a reservation output; it is later CONSUMED on commit or RELEASED/expired. A reservation can never be consumed twice (inherits the USO double-commit guarantee), and an expired reservation cannot mutate protected state (liveness: aborted reservation is eventually released).  • BoundedCounterEscrow — divides decrement rights for a scarce quantity among holders so each can withdraw from its local grant WITHOUT coordination, while preserving the lower-bound invariant (quantity never drops below the floor). Coordination is only needed when a holder exhausts its grant and must be rebalanced. This is the escrow / bounded-counter CRDT pattern.

## Classes

### `class ReservationManager`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(usoRegistry)` |  |
| `reserve` | `reserve({ resource, holder, expiryEpoch = null } = {})` | Reserve a resource for a holder until `expiryEpoch` (operational time). Creates a reservation USO; returns its id. |
| `isActive` | `isActive(reservationId, epoch = null)` | True if the reservation is unspent and not past its expiry at `epoch`. |
| `consume` | `consume(reservationId, epoch = null, byTx = 'reservation-consume')` | Consume a reservation (the holder commits). Fails if expired or already consumed/released — guaranteeing it is honored at most once. |
| `release` | `release(reservationId, byTx = 'reservation-release')` | Release a reservation (holder abandons it or it expired). Marks the reservation USO spent so it can never be consumed afterward. |

### `class BoundedCounterEscrow`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(total, floor = 0)` |  |
| `available` | `get available()` | Withdrawable headroom not yet granted to any holder. |
| `withdrawn` | `get withdrawn()` | Total withdrawn across all holders. |
| `remaining` | `get remaining()` | Remaining quantity above the floor (pool + all outstanding grants). |
| `balance` | `balance(holder)` | A holder's local (coordination-free) withdrawal rights. |
| `grant` | `grant(holder, amount)` | Grant part of the ungranted pool to a holder as local withdrawal rights. Returns the amount actually granted (may be less than requested). |
| `withdraw` | `withdraw(holder, n)` | Withdraw `n` from a holder's LOCAL grant — no coordination required while the holder has rights. Preserves the lower-bound invariant because the sum of all grants never exceeds `total`. |
| `reclaim` | `reclaim(holder)` | Return unused local rights to the shared pool (e.g. holder going offline). |
| `invariantHolds` | `invariantHolds()` | The lower-bound invariant the escrow guarantees holds at all times. |
| `_initialTotal` | `_initialTotal()` |  |
